page.title: Stegosauria
page.meta_description: Stegosauria is the plate-backed clade whose type, Stegosaurus, defines the Morrison's odd-armored herbivores. Related pages: Stegosaurus, Ornithischia.
page.content:
Plated, spiked ornithischians of the Jurassic.

How Stegosauria connects

  • Item: Stegosaurus — Stegosaurus is the type genus of Stegosauria.
  • Topic: Ornithischia — Stegosaurs are the plated ornithischians of the Jurassic.

What is Stegosauria?

Stegosauria is the plate-backed clade whose type, Stegosaurus, defines the Morrison's odd-armored herbivores.

Key threads lead to Stegosaurus and Ornithischia.
